messages:
erin: follow-up from design sync: we need a concrete migration/playbook for enabling low-bit precision across customer endpoints. focus = minimize surprise for customers + measurable cost ROI.
marco: +1. two parts: (A) annotation and defaults, (B) canary + billing adjustments.
lina: for (A) I propose we default to opt-in with an explicit onboarding consent flow. annotate endpoints with `precision_opt_in=true` and `recommended_profile_id` so console shows "recommended: 1% quality loss -> ~25% token cost savings".
der: whoa small typo: i mean dan: how do we compute the recommendation reliably without each customer running full evals?
erin: pipeline: use model-catalog curves + workload fingerprinting sample (5k requests shadowed) to estimate delta and variance. show customers mean ± std and a suggested guardrail.
marco: add a conservative policy: set `safety_margin_pct = max(0.5, measured_std * 2)` so the suggested target_quality_loss = measured_mean + safety_margin. keeps us conservative by default.
lina: good. for canary (B) we should phase: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% live lowbit over 2 weeks, with automatic rollback if regression rate > threshold. regression definition = unacceptable answer rate from eval anchors.
dan: how do we instrument regression detection cheaply? per-request degscore + sampled anchor checks. trigger if degscore drift > 0.8*threshold or sampled anchor failure rate > 0.5% absolute.
erin: also need customer-visible controls: a "pause lowbit" button and an opt-out audit log. customers must be able to see per-endpoint ledger rows for all lowbit trades.
ops-bot: reminder: infra PR #1102 touches retention, make sure retention aligns with customer opt-out flow.
marco: on billing: we can't retroactively change invoices. plan: show estimated monthly savings in console and bill normally. offer a manual rebate program for early adopters if they accept experimental lowbit flag.
lina: also surface cost vs quality curve in console: slider that shows estimated cost delta vs quality delta using catalog curves. customers can pick a point or accept recommended.
dan: edge case: multi-tenant endpoints where teams disagree. we need per-caller overrides. SDK header `x-precision-allow` with JWT-scoped permissions. ledger must record override_actor.
erin: privacy note: don't store full prompts in ledger—store hashed fingerprint and trace id only. we already discussed this in ledger RFC.
marco: long-term: integrate degcost curves into policy engine so routing can do bin-packing across models and bitpaths for global unit-cost minimization. not needed for migration MVP.
lina: rollouts: ops should run a 48h internal pilot on summarization+search endpoints, then invite three low-risk customers for a beta before general availability.
dan: SLO contract suggestion: allow customers to set `max_quality_loss_pct` and `monitoring_window_days`. if drift observed, runtime auto-opts the endpoint back to baseline and notifies customer.
erin: question: can we offer an "economics guarantee" (e.g., minimum X% token saving) with refund? probably risky initially, suggest a pilot rebate instead.
marco: agree. also add a QA checklist: onboarding anchors, shadow-sample >=5k, telemetry tags present, ledger retention policy confirmed, role-based ACL for ledger, canary config, billing advisory.
nina: small nit: use consistent tag names: `precision.profile.id`, `precision.chosen_bitpath`, `precision.pred_delta_pct`. I'll open a telemetry PR.
marco: timeline: draft migration RFC appendix this week, pilot next week, beta with customers in 3 wks. who wants to own the appendix?
erin: I'll draft the appendix and include checklist + console mockups. ping me for numbers.
dan: I'll run the shadow-sample job and provide delta estimates for two models.
marco: ops-bot queued: shadow-sample-job #990 (ETA ~2h). thanks all. we'll sync again after appendix is up. :thumbsup:
